nodes.label: Marine protected areas

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What aspect of Marine Protected Areas in Madeira has been poorly studied?
nodes.answer: The overall vulnerability of the MPAs in Madeira is still poorly studied.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How many Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) are currently in the Madeira Archipelago?
nodes.answer: There are nine Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) currently in the Madeira Archipelago.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is one of the notable features of the largest no-take MPA in Europe located in Madeira?
nodes.answer: It is exclusively a no-take MPA and ensures the full protection of over 25% of Madeira's territorial waters.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some threats faced by Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) in Madeira?
nodes.answer: Threats include overexploitation (such as illegal fishing), pollution, climate change, tourism (like scuba diving), and bioinvasions (introduction of non-indigenous species).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_004
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What percentage of national maritime space must EU member states classify as marine protected areas by 2030?
nodes.answer: EU member states must classify 30% of their national maritime space as marine protected areas (MPAs) by 2030.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are some benefits of marine protected areas according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Marine protected areas promote the increase in biomass, density, abundance, species richness, and specimen size.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_006
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How have marine protected areas been proposed to contribute to marine resource management?
nodes.answer: Marine protected areas have been proposed as a management tool to effectively contribute to the sustainable exploitation of marine resources.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_007
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What did a previous experimental study in Madeira find regarding local MPA communities and NIS colonization?
nodes.answer: It found that local MPA communities showed lower NIS colonization than communities outside protected areas.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Ocean governance|Marine protected areas_qna_008
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What do the results indicate regarding NIS risks in MPAs?
nodes.answer: The results indicate higher NIS risks in MPAs, which is supported by increased maritime traffic related to dive operations.
